summary.plain: FINUDA reported evidence for 6ΛH, a very neutron-rich hypernucleus made of a Λ particle bound to a hydrogen-5 core, by seeing correlated positive and negative pions from stopped kaons on lithium-6 targets.
summary.technical: FINUDA at DAΦNE: evidence for the neutron-rich hypernucleus 6ΛH from (π⁺, π⁻) pairs in coincidence, K⁻ stop + ⁶Li → 6ΛH + π⁺ followed by 6ΛH → ⁶He + π⁻; the production rate of the two-body π⁻ decay channel is (2.9 ± 2.0)×10⁻⁶ per stopped K⁻ and B_Λ(6ΛH) = (4.0 ± 1.1) MeV relative to ⁵H + Λ (Phys. Rev. Lett. 108 (2012) 042501).

title: Evidence for 6ΛH
why_it_matters: The abstract presents the observation as evidence, not a discovery, for a hypernucleus built on a particle-unstable nuclear core.
